figures.finding: No minimum is set for performers as such; the only statutory wage floor is for Emiratis employed in the private sector, AED 6,000 a month from 1 January 2026 (up from AED 5,000), set by the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.

value.appliesTo: UAE nationals employed in the private sector (new, renewed and amended work permits)

figures.applies: United Arab Emirates, Emirati employees of private-sector companies (an Emirati actor engaged as an employee), from 2026-01-01; no floor for expatriates found.

sources.said: The UAE Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) has announced an increase in the minimum wage for Emiratis employed in the private sector to AED 6,000 per month, effective 1 January 2026. … previously raised the minimum salary for Emiratis from AED 4,000 to AED 5,000, and now to AED 6,000.

figures.finding: Arabic is the official language of the UAE.

sources.said: The official language of the UAE is Arabic
